expectations: Requires localized tooltips for IconButton or other action buttons
Requires informative images to provide a localized semanticLabel
Allows decorative images only when excluded from semantics explicitly
Requires touch targets of at least 48x48 for tappable controls
Prefers Text.rich over RichText when it preserves text scaling and accessibility
Rejects hardcoded tooltip, semanticLabel, label, and visible accessibility copy in widgets
Mentions analyzer/lint coverage such as prefer_action_button_tooltip, avoid_missing_image_alt, avoid_hardcoded_strings, prefer_text_rich, or a11y_text_scale_clamp

evals.prompt: A reusable Flutter Riverpod widget under `presentation/widgets/` stores `List<Entity> _pageStack`, `Entity? _selected`, branches between child-list and article behavior, calls `context.pop()`, and reads a repository provider. Refactor the ownership and name the analyzer enforcement.
expectations: Keeps presentation/widgets focused on immutable view inputs and typed callback outputs
Moves page stacks, selected domain records, and workflow branching to a screen, typed route, or generated notifier/provider
Moves repository, service, SDK, and provider mutation access out of the reusable widget
Allows widget State to own UI lifecycle controllers, focus nodes, animations, and cancellable UI timers only
Uses typed callbacks such as onItemTap and onBack for widget dispatch
Names presentation_widget_navigation_forbidden, presentation_widget_controller_state, and presentation_widget_infrastructure_dependency

evals.prompt: A Flutter Windows release used to run build_runner before flutter build. We split quality onto Ubuntu, kept the Windows compile in another job, ignored generated .g.dart/.freezed.dart files, and used git diff to claim generation was committed. The new lane also guesses Inno paths, parses multi-line git output directly with PowerShell regex, and launches a GUI installer without waiting. Give the exact correction and proof plan without wasting paid Windows retries.
expectations: Identifies the job-boundary migration as the root regression and inventories the last green workflow's required step ordering before replacement
Requires flutter pub get, source-changing version materialization, and dart run build_runner build in every consuming job before analyze or native build
Rejects -d and --delete-conflicting-outputs because current build_runner deletes conflicts automatically
Rejects git diff as proof for ignored generated files and requires an ephemeral tracked-only clean-checkout generation plus analyze/build proof
Requires generated outputs to be tracked, regenerated in the consuming job, or transferred as an explicit verified artifact
Normalizes PowerShell multi-line native output to one scalar before regex and captures native process exit immediately
Wraps uncertain PowerShell pipeline or cmdlet output in @() before count, indexing, or exact-one checks and covers zero, one, and many results
Resolves exact pinned tool paths instead of guessing Program Files and uses Start-Process -Wait -PassThru for GUI/bootstrap executables
Distinguishes C/C++ include order, include directories, link libraries, and runtime DLL bundling, with proof on Windows
Discovers the resolved Windows release output and asserts the exact runtime DLL set beside the EXE instead of assuming installed CRT tools stage it
Uses explicit least-privilege GitHub authentication for private-repository reads when checkout credentials are not persisted
Compares the immediate before/after tracked-path delta instead of requiring a clean whole workspace after legitimate setup
Verifies the installed Inno version/directives, stable AppId, binary numeric and textual version fields, compiler exit, and upgrade/failure preservation with pre-existing user paths
Requires field-specific installer identity diagnostics and safe whitespace normalization instead of one opaque aggregate verifier exception
Runs cheap independent checks in parallel, one nonpublishing Windows diagnostic before one publisher, and cancels downstream paid work after prerequisite failure

evals.prompt: Add Sentry to an existing Flutter Riverpod app that already uses the skill's Crash facade and Firebase Crashlytics. The DSN was supplied, CI has an upload token, release builds are obfuscated, and we need enough evidence to diagnose a real device failure without leaking identity or duplicating reports. What exact design and proof should the skill require?
expectations: Treats adding Sentry or dual reporting as a material telemetry/privacy decision and preserves the accepted provider scope
Keeps all Firebase and Sentry SDK calls inside the provider-neutral Crash facade with public init, log, and error only
Uses SentryFlutter.init with appRunner as the single SDK-managed startup/error integration instead of adding manual global handlers
Treats the DSN as a public client destination in one environment-aware config owner while keeping SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN build-only and out of source, runtime config, arguments, and output
Disables default PII and unapproved screenshots, view hierarchy, replay, user identity, request capture, tracing, and profiling, plus scrubs app-owned event context
Ensures manual events reach each explicitly accepted provider once without duplicate calls
Proves no-DSN and init-failure startup, once-only sends, and PII scrubber fixtures
Matches build revision, Sentry release/dist, artifact, and retained obfuscation debug output
Requires an approved controlled event on the installed artifact and Sentry readback showing the exact release and symbolicated in-app frame
Routes Sentry issue investigation and resolution to the global sentry skill rather than duplicating its CLI workflow

evals.prompt: A verified Sentry issue from a Flutter Riverpod app points to a notifier writing state after an await when its provider was disposed. Use the event as evidence, fix the local lifecycle defect, and explain which skill owns each part without changing telemetry scope.
expectations: Uses the global sentry skill only for scoped runtime issue evidence and deployed verification
Routes reproducible local root-cause work through diagnosing-bugs rather than treating Sentry or Seer output as proof by itself
Reads the error-reporting and async-mutation/lifecycle references for the Flutter change
Guards post-await state writes with ref.mounted and makes finally cleanup conditional on ref.mounted
Preserves the accepted provider, privacy, sampling, and release configuration because the telemetry scope did not change
Keeps provider SDK calls outside the notifier and reports caught errors through the Crash facade
Proves the regression locally and verifies the exact deployed revision against the scoped Sentry issue before resolving it
Does not duplicate Sentry CLI commands or issue-resolution policy inside the Flutter skill

evals.prompt: A Flutter Riverpod iOS app works from one Xcode launch, but a later test/build command rewrites FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage to an empty graph and the physical-device launch fails. The machine has multiple Xcode installations. What should the skill require before another device retry?
expectations: Records the resolved DEVELOPER_DIR or xcode-select path, Xcode build, and Flutter/Dart version before native generation
Verifies the Flutter SwiftPM generated-package target and Run Prepare Flutter Framework Script pre-action for the exact flavor scheme
Separates tracked Xcode migration bytes from ios/Flutter/ephemeral generated package bytes
Identifies which command rewrites the generated package graph and verifies the post-command package products
Regenerates immediately before the device build or run under the same resolved Xcode environment
Rejects a prior IDE cache or a different Xcode selection as device-build proof
Avoids restoring or committing generated Apple package side effects as if they were tracked project changes
Runs the cheapest configuration/package-graph proof before another physical-device build

evals.prompt: This Flutter Riverpod app has no Sentry, no Crashlytics, and no accepted telemetry requirement. I am only fixing a notifier lifecycle bug. Does the building-flutter-apps skill require me to add a Crash facade or choose a reporting provider?
expectations: States that Sentry, Crashlytics, and no remote provider are all valid project-owned choices
Does not install a provider, create a Crash facade, add DSN configuration, or request a telemetry choice for this unrelated fix
Treats the error-reporting rule and checklist as not applicable when no provider is accepted or present
Fixes and proves the notifier lifecycle defect through the matching state-management references
Does not infer telemetry consent from the existence of the building-flutter-apps skill
